races.verdict: MR MCWHINNY hasn't looked back since joining this yard, recording a third success from his last 4 starts at Sedgefield on Monday. Remaining well treated under a 7-lb penalty, Tom Ellis' 8-y-o is strongly fancied to continue his winning spree. My Cullen enjoys a 7 lb turnaround with the selection from their recent C&D clash, but he may have to settle for silver again, with the returning Rule Me In best of the rest. races.verdict: Marginal preference in this wide-open listed event is for ELARAK who is taken to gain a deserved first success of the season on the back of a good second in listed company at Newmarket. Fondo Blanco also arrives in fine fettle and seems sure to go well but might have to settle for a place again. Spy Chief could bounce back after being poorly drawn in the Wokingham and the upwardly-mobile All Moonshine needs factoring in too. ELARAK FONDO BLANCO SPY CHIEF

races.verdict: PAVILION END hasn't won since scoring on Flat debut over C&D back in January 2025 but Charles O'Brien's 6-y-o has been knocking on the door in recent weeks so gets the nod to double his tally. Nakasero bounced back to his best when finding only Diamond Exchange too strong at Naas last month and that pair can chase home the selection in that order. PAVILION END NAKASERO (IRE) DIAMOND EXCHANGE (IRE)

races.verdict: BEGGARS ROCK arrives chasing a hat-trick after a pair of wins over fences, including at this track, and is taken to exploit his lower hurdles mark. Calm Flight Ahead was much improved when scoring at Sligo last time and rates the chief threat despite a 12 lb rise, while Quint Major has shown signs of a revival and is also respected. BEGGARS ROCK (IRE) CALM FLIGHT AHEAD (IRE) QUINT MAJOR (IRE)

races.verdict: WHISPERING WILLOW shaped with encouragement in a couple of starts over fences earlier in the season and, after taking a notable step back in the right direction over hurdles recently, she looks worth siding with in an ordinary maiden chase. Kalsman rarely runs a bad race at this track and rates the main danger after finishing second over fences last time, while Sea of Doubt is another to consider. WHISPERING WILLOW (IRE) KALSMAN (IRE) SEA OF DOUBT (IRE)

races.verdict: IFUKNOWUKNOW showed some promise in a pair of bumpers last season, including when behind subsequent Champion Bumper winner The Mourne Rambler in a very warm race at Leopardstown when last seen, and he could well be up to making a winning start for his new yard, especially with this slightly longer trip sure to be in his favour. Myluckymaker sets the standard and should give her running once more, while newcomer Thranduil ticks plenty of boxes on paper. IFUKNOWUKNOW (IRE) MYLUCKYMAKER (IRE) THRANDUIL (IRE)
